pages.text: Old samples remain sealed and old readings remain old. The kit describes the patient at the moment of collection.
pages.title: A sealed sample
Take a fresh reading
pages.text: Craft it from a glass bottle, iron, copper and a dormant flake. Sneak-use draws a nonlethal sample costing one heart. Use normally to read its infection level, stage and age. Draw again to check a change.

pages.title: After contact
pages.text: Exposure begins with contact with living tissue or an infected body. Some affected creatures shake even while standing still; several may turn towards the same disturbance.

pages.title: After contact
pages.text: Early exposure can subside once contact stops. A Disruption Charm in the offhand or a Curios charm slot blocks new infection. It does not erase a dose already present. Give recovery time, then check a fresh sample.
The journal teaches the assay; the kit holds the blood and measured result.
